motion_summary: Eternal Return Magnus Bike Escape: bulky biker with orange spiky hair, strong blue eyes, black sleeveless leather outfit and heavy club per reference. R starts a MOTORCYCLE, accelerates riding, then dismounts and sends motorcycle forward to crash. No background road; bike is unique R equipment. Sequence: standing ready; crouch and reach handlebars; black/red motorcycle materializes under him; mount saddle; rev with small wheel smoke; lean forward accelerating; bike wheel lifts slightly and torso leans; jump off bike with boots clearly separated from saddle; motorcycle alone drives forward-right as Magnus lands behind; small contained orange collision burst beside bike, not covering face; motorcycle dissolves and club regripped; standing ready. Keep both Magnus and motorcycle small enough to fit with 15 percent transparent margin in every square; no extra rider. Correct muscular chibi identity, not Nia's slender body.
visual_review: 승차, 가속, 바이크 이탈, 바이크 단독 전진/충돌을 확인했습니다. 0-based 8,9는 바이크만 보여주는 R 재사용 연출입니다.
